John West Chunk Style Tuna in Springwater offers a pure and natural taste with no added flavours. This canned tuna is packed in clean spring water, ensuring that the quality of the premium tuna shines through. With a 4.5 health star rating, this option is perfect for health-conscious consumers looking to incorporate more protein into their diets. Ideal for a variety of dishes, this tuna can be used in salads, sandwiches, or mixed into rice dishes. Try it in a refreshing tuna bean salad or combine it with brown rice for a nutritious meal. Sustainably sourced and MSC-certified, this John West tuna allows you to enjoy delicious meals while supporting responsible fishing practices. Make it a staple in your pantry for all your meal prep needs!
It's what John West rejects that makes John West the best.

- 4.5 health star rating
